How We Work

Standard Cabinets or
a One-Off Showpiece

Some jobs are straightforward — a run of kitchen cabinets, done right. Others are the piece a homeowner's been picturing for years: a built-in library, a custom hood surround, something no catalog sells. We build both the same way, starting with a real conversation about what you need.

We're built and staffed like a local shop, but we build and ship projects all over the country. Wherever the job is, you get the same thing our East Tennessee clients get: real conversations, a crew that answers the phone, and cabinetry built to last — not a call center and a tracking number.
